question: What outcome follows from abstaining from food during the day?
premises: The practitioner abstains from eating by day.
This abstention has a future consequence.
The consequence concerns age and death.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death by aging.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ may mean overcoming or passing beyond age-related death.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
